Overview

Palermo is a city in Sicily with a population of 635,000. Sicily’s vibrant capital, a melting pot of cultures with Norman palaces, Byzantine mosaics, bustling markets, and stunning Mediterranean coastline. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
